answer: The vine of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on token-curated registries for quality signals. A ferrous of per-task receipts records who did what, and the mirror of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a systems thinking, emergent properties highlighted register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
